scope: Attachment availability through original source writing and post-freeze verification; integration milestones are recorded separately.

clock.start_proxy_basis: Modification time of the attachment supplied to this session; exact coding-request receipt timestamp is not exposed. This includes the initial clarification exchange.

total_unique_session_content_through_sou.includes: Prompt, inherited conversation/instructions, tool-returned text, generated reasoning, source, and administrative authoring text; repeated prefix retransmission is not counted.
total_unique_session_content_through_sou.basis: Retrospective order-of-magnitude estimate from session content, not a tokenizer or usage meter.

tokens.file_estimation_method: Character-count heuristic: prose roughly 3.5–5 characters/token; Rust roughly 3–4 characters/token. The served model tokenizer and usage counters are not exposed.
tokens.billing_caveat: Actual API/billed total cannot be recovered here. It can differ substantially because of repeated context, caching, hidden runtime accounting, and reasoning tokens. Do not treat the estimate as a usage receipt.

total_unique_session_content_through_wor.basis: Retrospective content-volume estimate including the earlier source milestone, repository/tool output and integration work; excludes repeated prefix retransmission. Exact API or billed totals are not observable.

note: The requested Max filename is an identifier, not proof of an independently observed inference-effort setting.
